package.description: Adaptive on-screen keyboard with local word prediction.

en-US.description: Adaptive on-screen keyboard with local word prediction.
en-US.longDescription: Klaavi is an adaptive on-screen keyboard designed to support accessible text input. Word prediction runs locally on the device and typed text is not sent to Klaavi servers. An internet connection may be required for downloads, updates, trial activation and PRO licensing.
en-US.name: Klaavi
